title: Oncaller presence prober and smart snooze: reduce pager noise during focused windows
author: Nina Park
release_notes: Introduce an oncaller presence probe and opt-in smart-snooze policy that reduces noisy notifications when an oncall is marked as focused; adds metrics and CLI flags. Rolling rollout behind feature flag.
description:
Motivation: oncall responders often get noisy noise during focused work sessions (meetings, deep debugging) which reduces effectiveness. This PR adds a lightweight presence prober that infers focused windows from calendar/Slack activity and explicit mobile/desktop heartbeats, and an opt-in smart-snooze policy that auto-suppresses low-severity pages or routes them to a backup channel.

What this change does: - Adds a presence_prober component that consumes optional signals (Slack status, calendar free/busy, heartbeat pings from the mobile app). The prober emits short-lived 'focus' annotations to the incident-bot decision layer. - Implements smart snooze policy which: (1) auto-snoozes non-critical alerts for an oncaller marked as 'focused' for a configurable window (default 30m), (2) escalates to secondary responders after a configurable grace period, (3) records decisions for audit. - Adds a small CLI and WebUI toggle to opt a user into smart-snooze and to view recent automated snoozes. - Implements a noise-calibrator tool that analyzes historical alerts to suggest severity thresholds and suppression rules for a team.

Backward compatibility & rollout: default is OFF. Feature gated by experiment flag 'smart_snooze_v1' and requires oncall to opt-in. All routing decisions remain auditable and reversible.

Checklist: - [x] Presence prober implementation and unit tests - [x] Smart-snooze decision engine + tests - [x] Metrics (snooze.count, snooze.reason, calibrator.suggestions) - [x] CLI/web toggles - [x] Docs and howto in docs/oncall/smart-snooze.md - [x] Feature flag gating and rollout plan

How to test locally: run 'make dev' then 'bin/incident-bot --enable-experiments=smart_snooze_v1' and use the test harness 'scripts/simulate-heartbeats --user nina@example.com --focus start' to create focus windows. Use calibrator via 'bin/noise-calibrator analyze --lookback 30d --team infra'.

Security/Privacy: presence signals are optional and only stored as ephemeral annotations (TTL 7d). The privacy doc was updated and linked in docs/privacy/presence-prober.md.

Related work: builds on prior auto-triage features (ENG-2104) and the earlier pager-noise profiling (SRE-72). Linked SUP ticket for a customer request: SUP-921.
